question: Should OpenClaw adopt `local`, `container`, `reverse-proxy`, and `node-mode` as the initial opt-in, release-tested hosting-profile catalog once readiness is accepted?
rationale: The proposal creates new product and support commitments rather than repairing established behavior, so patch mechanics cannot resolve acceptance.

options.title: Adopt the initial catalog
options.body: Accept the four opt-in profiles, with implementation separately gated on the readiness RFC and core-owner review.

options.title: Narrow the catalog
options.body: Accept the approach but defer postures whose support and conformance ownership are not yet established.

options.title: Defer the profiles
options.body: Keep readiness independently scoped and postpone named hosting contracts.

recommendation.title: Adopt the initial catalog
recommendation.body: Accept the four opt-in profiles, with implementation separately gated on the readiness RFC and core-owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposal and its current revisions; broader owner history could not be inspected.
